major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it once Divine Toll is within 10 seconds of ready, then spend the 20 second window dumping Holy Power while Judgment is empowered into Hammer of Wrath.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hold it for Avenging Wrath and cast it once that buff is up so Divine Resonance fires a free Avenger's Shield every 5 seconds for 15 seconds; without Righteous Protector send it when Avenging Wrath is under 30 seconds out.

major_cooldowns.name: Sacred Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Lightsmith only: put the armament out whenever Avenging Wrath is not active, refreshing it when the buff has under 6 seconds left.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Holy Armaments cast the guide names as Sacred Weapon; name-verified but not observed in the sampled Templar parse.

rule.description: Open Avenging Wrath into Divine Toll and Hammer of Light
rule.action: Pre-place Consecration and pull with Hand of Reckoning, then open Avenging Wrath into Divine Toll and Hammer of Light before falling into the priority.
Hold Divine Toll for Avenging Wrath and press Avenging Wrath when Divine Toll is within 10 seconds of ready, so both 60 second Divine Tolls per Wrath cycle land inside the window.

rule.description: Avenger's Shield consumes every Vanguard proc
rule.action: Judgment and Hammer of Wrath grant Vanguard; spend it with Avenger's Shield above everything except your cooldowns, since it returns up to 3 Holy Power and empowers the next Shield of the Righteous.

rule.description: Shield of the Righteous armor buff stays up
rule.action: Keep the armor buff active for nearly all of combat: chain Holy Power spends while tanking and pool Holy Power during downtime so the next pack is covered.

rule.description: Stand in Consecration at all times
rule.action: Recast Consecration the moment you are not standing in it, and use it as the filler when everything else is on cooldown to refresh the 12 second duration.

rule.description: Shield of the Righteous at high Holy Power
rule.action: Spend between 3 and 5 Holy Power, favouring 4 or 5 so a dump at exactly 3 does not leave you empty for the next hit, and never press a generator while sitting at 5.
